resources.string: Slower steps, limits, and confirmation before writes
On by default. Turn this off to remove the extra pauses, limits and confirmations.

When this is on, Mika waits a random few seconds between steps, caps how much it does in each app, and stops if a safety check appears. It never tries to pass that check. WeChat, Xiaohongshu, Taobao, Xianyu and JD ask you before sending, posting, commenting, liking, following, ordering, paying, or changing a price. Xianyu also asks before refreshing a listing.
Each wait is chosen at random between these two numbers. It is not the same every time.

A safety check means text such as “too many actions”, a slider or puzzle, or face verification. Mika stops, tells you, and pauses that app for 24 hours. It does not drag the slider or try to pass the check.
